payoff.summary: I can speak about a world that does not exist, and say it depends when the condition is still open.
payoff.note: ES-C56-depende (sequence 2287) is the chapter's last lesson and assesses both atoms the chapter introduces (2/2), plus the unreal condition its can-do promises. The synthesis ES-C56-sintesis-condiciones (2285) introduces nothing and comes before depende, so as payoff it could assess none of the chapter's atoms (0/2). Depende now closes on an open condition (depende) beside a closed one (si tuviera tiempo, comería en casa), recalled from the chapters before, so the payoff still asks for speech about a world that does not exist; the can-do names the open condition too.
